en.commentary: LED face masks have gone fully mainstream in 2026, with more than thirty brands spanning $250 to $1,900, and the gap between the best and the rest comes down to clinical evidence and wavelength depth. CurrentBody Skin Series 2 takes my top spot because its third 1072nm near-infrared wavelength reaches collagen layers that no other flexible mask touches, and the anti-aging results back it up after eight weeks of nightly use. Omnilux Contour Face sits right behind on the strength of the most published clinical studies in the category, which is why dermatologists name it directly. The story of the year is Shark CryoGlow at number three: its under-eye cooling plates solve the puffiness complaint every other mask leaves on the table, and at $350 it does more jobs than masks costing twice as much. Dr. Dennis Gross earns its spot for sheer speed, finishing a red-and-blue session in three minutes. At the value end, HigherDOSE and Solawave deliver real anti-aging spectrum for under $400. The one I would skip is Foreo FAQ 202: it is the most comfortable mask here, yet at $599 the results do not come close to justifying the price.

highlights.title: CurrentBody Series 2 wins because its 1072nm wavelength reaches deeper than anything flexible
highlights.body: The third near-infrared wavelength at 1072nm is what separates this mask from the field. Most flexible masks stop at 633nm red and 830nm near-infrared, and that combination works for surface tone and fine lines. The deeper 1072nm penetrates to the collagen layers that drive long-term firmness, and across eight weeks of nightly ten-minute sessions I measured visibly tighter skin along the jaw and under the eyes. The 236-LED count gives even coverage, and the flexible fit means light actually reaches the cheeks and forehead instead of floating above them.

highlights.title: Shark CryoGlow is the smartest multi-tasker of 2026
highlights.body: The under-eye cooling plates are the feature every other brand should have copied by now. Puffy eyes are the single most common complaint among LED mask users, and Shark built the fix directly into the mask: chilled plates that depuff the under-eye area while the red, blue, and infrared LEDs run their cycle. At $350 it treats wrinkles and acne and morning puffiness in one ten-minute sit, which is why it punches above masks that cost twice as much and only do one thing.

highlights.title: Omnilux earns the dermatologist endorsement with published evidence
highlights.body: Clinical proof is the whole game in this category, and Omnilux has more of it than anyone. The Contour Face pairs 633nm red with 830nm near-infrared in medical-grade silicone, and the brand has run the published studies that let skin doctors recommend it by name rather than by hope. If you want the mask with the deepest research record behind its anti-aging claims, this is the one, and the flexible fit makes the ten-minute sessions easy to keep up.

highlights.title: Skip the Foreo FAQ 202 — comfort cannot carry a $599 price
highlights.body: The FAQ 202 is the most pleasant mask here to wear, ultra-light silicone that molds to the face across 600 points of light. The problem is what happens after you take it off. Independent testing puts its real-world results near the bottom of the category, and at $599 it costs more than masks with deeper wavelengths and stronger clinical records. Comfort matters, but you are buying results, and on that measure the price is impossible to defend.

這週看到最實用的一則消息，是 Forbes 做了長達四個月的實測，最後把總冠軍給了 Dr. Dennis Gross DRx SpectraLite FaceWare Pro。他們的理由跟我的判斷方向一致：三種預設模式、單次三分鐘、充飽一次可以撐八到十天的每日使用。老實說，這個品類真正的勝負在於你撐不撐得完療程。一台你願意連續用滿十二週的機器，價值遠高於一台規格漂亮但第三週就被丟進抽屜的機器。

有件事這個月每一篇評測都在講，我也再說一次：這種產品的效果是慢慢累積的。合理的做法是在固定光線下拍好前後對比照，第十二週再來下結論。價格上這類機器普遍落在一台中階手機的水準，慎選一次比買三台便宜的划算太多。

en.commentary:
The thing that separates a real LED mask from an expensive light-up accessory is irradiance, and almost nobody publishes it. Irradiance is the power density delivered to your skin, measured in milliwatts per square centimetre, and the clinical studies these products cite ran at specific irradiance levels for specific durations. A mask that delivers a fraction of that power needs proportionally longer sessions to reach the same dose, and most of them do not tell you.

The CurrentBody Skin Series 2 holds first at 9.4 because it publishes its output, holds clinical-grade irradiance across the full mask surface, and covers the wavelengths with the strongest evidence behind them. Red at 633 nanometres for collagen stimulation and near infrared at 830 for deeper tissue are the two that the research actually supports.

The Omnilux Contour Face at 9.2 has the deepest clinical trial history in this category, and the flexible silicone construction contacts skin evenly across the face rather than leaving gaps at the cheekbones.

The Shark CryoGlow at 9.2 adds under-eye cooling, and for anyone whose primary concern is puffiness rather than fine lines, that combination is the more useful one.

One expectation to set clearly. Results in the published studies appear at eight to twelve weeks of consistent use, three to five sessions a week. Anyone who uses a mask twice and concludes it does nothing has not run the protocol. Consistency is the variable that determines the outcome.

highlights.title: Irradiance is the specification that decides whether it works
highlights.body: Clinical studies ran at specific power densities for specific durations, and a mask delivering a fraction of that power needs proportionally longer sessions to reach the same dose. Most manufacturers do not publish irradiance at all. If a brand will not state milliwatts per square centimetre, treat the clinical claims it cites as unrelated to the product in your hands.

highlights.title: CurrentBody Skin Series 2 publishes its output and holds it evenly
highlights.body: It states its irradiance, maintains clinical-grade output across the full mask surface rather than only at the centre, and covers 633 nanometre red and 830 nanometre near infrared, the two wavelengths with the strongest supporting research. That transparency plus even coverage is why it holds 9.4 in a category full of unverifiable claims.

highlights.title: Omnilux Contour Face has the deepest trial history
highlights.body: More published clinical work sits behind this device than any other in the category, and the flexible silicone contacts skin evenly across the face instead of bridging over the cheekbones and leaving gaps. Even contact matters because dose depends on distance, and a mask that floats above part of your face treats that part at a lower dose.

highlights.title: Run the protocol for eight to twelve weeks before judging
highlights.body: Published results appear at eight to twelve weeks of consistent use at three to five sessions per week. Anyone who uses a mask twice and concludes it does nothing has not run the protocol the evidence is based on. Consistency is the variable that determines the outcome, more than the choice between the top three devices here.

zh-tw.commentary:
分辨一台真正的 LED 面膜跟一個很貴的發光配件，關鍵在輻照度，而幾乎沒有品牌會公布這個數字。

輻照度是實際打到你皮膚上的功率密度，單位是每平方公分毫瓦，而這些產品引用的臨床研究，都是在特定輻照度下做特定時長。一台輸出只有那個數字一小部分的面膜，需要按比例拉長療程時間才能達到同樣劑量，而多數品牌不會告訴你這件事。

CurrentBody Skin Series 2 守第一，9.4 分，因為它公布輸出、在整片面膜表面維持臨床等級的輻照度，而且涵蓋的是證據最強的那兩個波長。633 奈米紅光刺激膠原、830 奈米近紅外進入較深組織，這兩個是研究真正支持的。

Omnilux Contour Face 9.2 分，臨床試驗紀錄是這個品類最深的，柔性矽膠結構讓它在整張臉上均勻貼合，不會在顴骨附近架空留縫。

Shark CryoGlow 9.2 分，多了眼下冷敷，主要困擾是浮腫而不是細紋的人，這個組合更實用。

最後把期待值講清楚。已發表研究裡的效果出現在持續使用八到十二週、每週三到五次之後。用兩次就判定它沒用的人，根本沒有執行那套療程。持續度才是決定結果的變數。

highlights.title: 輻照度是決定它有沒有用的規格
highlights.body: 臨床研究是在特定功率密度下做特定時長，輸出只有一小部分的面膜，需要按比例拉長時間才能達到同樣劑量。多數廠商根本不公布輻照度。品牌不肯講每平方公分毫瓦的話，就把它引用的臨床宣稱當成跟你手上這台無關。

highlights.body: 它標示輻照度，在整片面膜表面而不是只在中心維持臨床等級輸出，涵蓋 633 奈米紅光與 830 奈米近紅外這兩個研究支持最強的波長。在一個充滿無法查證宣稱的品類裡，這份透明加上均勻覆蓋就是 9.4 分的理由。

highlights.title: Omnilux Contour Face 的臨床紀錄最深
highlights.body: 這台背後的已發表臨床工作比這個品類任何一台都多，柔性矽膠在整張臉上均勻接觸，不會跨過顴骨留下空隙。均勻接觸很重要，因為劑量取決於距離，而架空的區域等於被用更低的劑量照射。

highlights.title: 先照八到十二週再下判斷
highlights.body: 已發表的效果出現在持續八到十二週、每週三到五次之後。用兩次就說沒效的人，並沒有執行證據所依據的那套療程。持續度對結果的影響，大過在這裡前三名之間怎麼選。
